sources: arXiv API http://export.arxiv.org/api/query (Atom; search_query, start, max_results=1000, sortBy=submittedDate, sortOrder=ascending; one request every 3.2 s; User-Agent 'SpinDrift-literature-builder/1.0 (NASA Space Apps 2026 entry; arXiv API and NCBI E-utilities only)')

NCBI E-utilities https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi (db=pubmed, retmax=10000) and https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi (POST, rettype=medline, 400 PMIDs per request; tool=SpinDrift-literature-builder, no e-mail; at most one request every 0.4 s)

Device's own paper: Zhao, Mammei & Fujimoto, 'QuSpin Zero-Field Magnetometer Characterization for the TUCAN Experiment', arXiv 2408.02941 (the QuSpin QZFM paper used by data/sensor_parts/opm.json) (arXiv:2408.02941); abstract and the open arXiv full text read
arxiv query 'optically_pumped_magnetometer': abs:"optically pumped" AND abs:magnetometer
arxiv query 'atomic_alkali_magnetometer': abs:magnetomet* AND (abs:atomic OR abs:alkali OR abs:rubidium OR abs:cesium OR abs:caesium OR abs:potassium OR abs:"vapor cell" OR abs:"vapour cell")
arxiv query 'serf': abs:SERF OR abs:"spin-exchange relaxation-free" OR abs:"spin exchange relaxation free"
arxiv query 'vapour_cell': abs:"vapor cell" OR abs:"vapour cell" OR abs:"vapor cells" OR abs:"vapour cells"
arxiv query 'rubidium_vapour_cell': abs:rubidium AND (abs:"vapor cell" OR abs:"vapour cell")
pubmed query 'opm_meg': (OPM[tiab] OR "optically pumped"[tiab]) AND (magnetoencephalography[tiab] OR MEG[tiab])
pubmed query 'magnetocardiography_opm': magnetocardiography[tiab] AND ("optically pumped"[tiab] OR OPM[tiab] OR atomic[tiab])
pubmed query 'vapour_cell': "vapor cell"[tiab] OR "vapour cell"[tiab] OR "vapor cells"[tiab] OR "vapour cells"[tiab]
meta.about: Hardware numbers stated in the device's own paper, each with its paper id and exact sentence. Parameters the paper does not state are NOT_FOUND. The literature harvest (official APIs only) is kept for counts: other papers' values are not written until the user asks to 'add typical'.
meta.policy: values only from the device's own paper (coordinator instruction, 15 Nov 2026); NOT_FOUND parameters carry value objects with status NOT_STATED and value null

own_paper.paper: Zhao, Mammei & Fujimoto, 'QuSpin Zero-Field Magnetometer Characterization for the TUCAN Experiment', arXiv 2408.02941 (the QuSpin QZFM paper used by data/sensor_parts/opm.json)
own_paper.access: abstract and the open arXiv full text read

queries.query: abs:magnetomet* AND (abs:atomic OR abs:alkali OR abs:rubidium OR abs:cesium OR abs:caesium OR abs:potassium OR abs:"vapor cell" OR abs:"vapour cell")
abs:SERF OR abs:"spin-exchange relaxation-free" OR abs:"spin exchange relaxation free"
abs:"vapor cell" OR abs:"vapour cell" OR abs:"vapor cells" OR abs:"vapour cells"
abs:rubidium AND (abs:"vapor cell" OR abs:"vapour cell")
magnetocardiography[tiab] AND ("optically pumped"[tiab] OR OPM[tiab] OR atomic[tiab])
"vapor cell"[tiab] OR "vapour cell"[tiab] OR "vapor cells"[tiab] OR "vapour cells"[tiab]

meta.dedup: by arXiv id, PMID and DOI (case-insensitive); a record found again keeps its first copy
meta.extraction: Text is normalised (LaTeX, Unicode and MEDLINE spellings of units, √Hz, °C, ×, ±, µ) on a copy that maps back to the original, so each quote and sentence is exact (whitespace runs collapsed; a PDF line break keeps its hyphen). A number counts only when its unit and the words next to it name the parameter (RULES in scripts/build_literature.py); bounds such as 'below', 'respectively' lists, areas or volumes where a length is meant, and values outside each parameter's plausible_range are rejected. In the device's own paper both ends of a stated range are kept.
meta.raw_cache: data/literature/raw/ (gzip of the exact response bytes; see raw/manifest.json); not in git (over 20 MB) and not in the public build
